comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The sociological depth of this documentary is outstanding. It’s so rare for a country to actually redirect military funding into universal healthcare and public education [09:49]. The fact that this choice directly resulted in a life expectancy of 80 years [10:48] and a 97% literacy rate is one of the most profound geopolitical lessons in the world. You laid out the cause and effect brilliantly without being preachy. Great work! 👏
